diagnosis: The native episode failed; approach_close was not used, so this is a preventive composition repair, not evidence that the old recipe caused the failure. Geometry: plane-height assumptions and TCP alignment did not establish final object-center or directed-heading accuracy; no geometry defect is proven. For <=3 degree final heading accuracy, mark tail-tip and crossbar-center in an enlarged head crop at step 0 (longest ~65mm baseline) to compute each piece's unit directed heading u_i and perpendicular p_i = [-u_iy, u_ix, 0]; choose sign s in {+1, -1} so s*(p_1 + p_2) has cy >= cx (keeping left wrist q6 near 0), and use s*p_1 for T1 pickup/buffer/T2-placement and s*p_2 for T2 pickup/T1-placement. Tracking: target-dependent motion failed when the stem became unobserved; use plan_relative_pose for short horizontal buffer moves, and rely on stationary overhead points or measured-TCP relative motion. Grasp: closure and TCP verification were not grasp proof; the transcript reports visual retention/release but does not establish final placement tolerances. Flow: long motions expanded beyond their nominal steps, leaving 17-27 actions when homing required 30-35; always start final home with at least 40 actions remaining and steps=12..20. Model/API: multi-seed IK with 4-keyframe Slerp interpolation and PD-lag-tolerant waypoint progression prevent wrist-limit stalls and stage-budget timeouts during large heading rotations.
